one_liner_ko: 간단한 프롬프트 한 줄로 보컬·가사·반주까지 갖춘 완성곡을 만드는 AI 음악 생성기.
what_it_does_ko: Suno는 텍스트 프롬프트 하나로 보컬, 가사, 전체 편곡이 들어간 완성곡을 1분 안에 만들어 주는 AI 음악 생성 서비스다. 브라우저 기반 DAW인 Suno Studio에서 곡을 편곡·편집·믹싱할 수 있다. 내 목소리를 녹음해 노래하게 하는 Voices, 스템 분리, 리믹스, 내 녹음으로 학습시키는 맞춤 모델 기능이 있다. 무료로 매일 곡을 만들 수 있고, 유료 구독자가 만든 곡은 상업적으로 쓸 수 있다.
use_cases_ko: 처음 음악을 만드는 일반인의 노래 만들기

evidence.quote: Suno is a music company building the world's first creative entertainment platform.
Start with a simple prompt or dive into our pro editing tools, your next track is just a step away.
Suno helps you create complete, original songs – vocals, lyrics, full production – from a single text prompt in under a minute, across every genre.
A browser-based DAW for arranging, editing and mixing every part of a song until it is exactly yours.
Record a few seconds of your own voice, then hear it sing anything you write, in any style.
Pull any song apart into clean, time-aligned stems and carry them into the DAW you already use.
Take a song somewhere new. Change its style, rewrite the lyrics or rebuild it around your own recording.
Train a model on your own recordings so every song it makes starts from your sound.
Browse songs by genre, mood and occasion, whether you need a reference, a spark or the right track for a project.
It's the go-to plan for content creators, songwriters, and anyone looking for royalty free music for YouTube, podcasts, ads, or any commercial project.
Suno is built for everyone – people making music for the first time and chart-topping pros alike.
Saves $24 by billing yearly! Taxes calculated at checkout
Access to Suno Studio - now with MIDI, effects, automation, and design-your-own-plugins
Songs you create as a paid Suno subscriber are yours to keep and do whatever you want with them
Full creative experiences on web, iOS and Android let the music travel with you.
